ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the nonprofit organization at the center of the federal corruption probe and its $94M city contract.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the nonprofit's financials, connections to government officials, and potential impact on the community.
questions: What are the nonprofit's ties to government officials?
How has the nonprofit used its $94M city contract?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of corruption and misuse of funds in Minnesota's nonprofit sector.

ideas.title: The Housing Stabilization Fraud Scheme: Who's Behind It?
ideas.description: Investigate the individuals and organizations involved in the multi-million dollar Housing Stabilization Fraud scheme in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Examine the alleged fraud scheme and identify key players, their connections, and potential impact on Minnesota residents.
questions: Who are the key players involved?
What was the scope of the alleged fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a complex web of individuals and organizations involved in large-scale fraud.
